# Veida AI Image Prompts

Unlimited free AI image generator. Sign in with Google to make pictures and edit your own photos on Veida AI Image v1 with no limit and no card.

This Espanso package provides 8 reusable prompt expansion triggers for browser-based text-to-image generation and photo editing workflows on [Veida AI](https://veida.ai/) and other image generators.

## Triggers

| Trigger | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `:vportrait` | Editorial portrait lighting and lens template |
| `:vproduct` | Commercial studio product photography prompt |
| `:vedit` | Identity-preserving photo edit instruction |
| `:vstyle` | Composition-preserving photo restyle instruction |
| `:vlight` | Golden-hour and cinematic lighting modifier |
| `:vposter` | Editorial graphic poster layout prompt |
| `:vicon` | Clean square app icon prompt |
| `:vscene` | Wide architectural and environmental scene prompt |

Each trigger places the cursor at `$|$` so you can immediately type your subject or edit instruction.
